title: Per-Step Review Sub-Loop prose duplicated in fix_signal and spec skills
description: fix_signal.skill.md defines the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop (steps 0–8, ~35 lines) verbatim twice: once for the signal pickup artifact (Phase 3) and once for the event artifact (Phase 5). spec.skill.md does the same: once for the spec file write (Phase 4) and once for the README patch (Phase 5). run.skill.md correctly defines the sub-loop once as a generic procedure that fires after every write_file or patch_file call within Phase 3. The duplicated prose adds ~35 prompt lines per redundant instance and creates a two-site maintenance surface in each affected skill: any change to sub-loop protocol (threshold, error preflight logic, step numbering) must be applied in multiple places per skill rather than one.
proposed_resolution: Refactor fix_signal.skill.md and spec.skill.md to follow run.skill.md's pattern: define the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop once in a single '## Per-Step Review Sub-Loop' section near the top of the skill body. Replace each call site with a one-line reference naming the target artifact and path, e.g. 'Run the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop for this artifact (path: <path>).' No behavioural change — only prose location changes.
